deliverables: Fund builders whose work is expected to improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Require funded projects to track core KPIs including monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Continue development of KPI tracking from self-reported dashboards toward live on-chain Cardano data.
Use an independent administrator/multisig to hold funds and disburse them after milestone validation.
Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury.
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with funds administered by an independent council/multisig composed of members of the dRep DAO before milestone-based disbursement.
request.what: Create or continue the Cardano Builder DAO as a smart contract-governed funding mechanism to allocate treasury resources to Cardano builders tied to ecosystem KPIs.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is intended to be an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed funding mechanism for projects advancing Cardano Vision 2030 KPIs.
The proposal identifies monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL as the core KPIs funded projects should improve and report against.
The DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
Round 1 funded 20 companies, included 38 voting members and 27 requesting members, distributed 5,541,335 ADA, and achieved 83% governance participation.
Round 2 added 18 new members, funded 14 companies, and achieved 88% member participation after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.
The DAO built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, moving from self-reported KPI tracking toward tracking tied to live on-chain Cardano data.
Official Cardano developer documentation is claimed to describe the CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions.

The administrator will keep ADA in separate community-auditable accounts, not delegate it to a stake pool operator, and delegate voting power to the predefined abstain option while funds await disbursement.
Milestone funds will be disbursed from an independent multisig only after completion is validated and confirmed by the administrator.
The CB DAO returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after the first two governance rounds, with a transaction link provided.

summary: The document proposes continuing or scaling the Cardano Builder DAO as a KPI-driven treasury funding mechanism for builders, but it does not state the requested ADA amount or include the referenced milestone and budget details in the anchor text.
